title: VideoDeck
description: VideoDeck is an open-source desktop application for managing local ONVIF/RTSP IP cameras, providing a live-view grid, manual and fixed-duration recordings, interval snapshots, recurrence-based schedules, and locally stored recording metadata. This record archives the released application binaries for macOS, Windows and Linux, together with their SHA-256 checksums. The source code for the tagged release is available on GitHub: https://github.com/alberdilab/videodeck
